observation.command:
cd /tmp && cat > seed.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
set -e
API=http://localhost:8081
TOKEN=$(curl -s -X POST $API/auth/signin -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"id":"admin","password":"admin"}' | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["accessToken"])')
echo "token ok: ${TOKEN:0:20}..."

TENANT_ID=$(curl -s -X POST $API/api/tenants -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"name":"Ulm Co-Learning","contactName":"Smart City Ulm","mail":"ulm@smart-city-booking.de"}' | python3 -c 'import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print(d.get("id") or d.get("tenantId") or d)')
echo "tenant_id=$TENANT_ID"

BOOKABLE_ID=$(curl -s -X POST $API/api/$TENANT_ID/bookables -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"title":"Raum A","type":"room","isPublic":true,"isBookable":true,"isScheduleRelated":true,"isTimePeriodRelated":true,"amount":1,"maxAmountPerBooking":1,"minBookingDuration":15,"maxBookingDuration":480}' | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["id"])')
echo "bookable_id=$BOOKABLE_ID"

# booking for today, starting 1h from now, 2h long (epoch ms)
NOW=$(date +%s%3N)
BEGIN=$(( (NOW/1000 + 3600) * 1000 ))
END=$(( (NOW/1000 + 3600 + 7200) * 1000 ))
echo "begin=$BEGIN end=$END"
curl -s -X POST $API/api/$TENANT_ID/bookings -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d "{\"timeBegin\":$BEGIN,\"timeEnd\":$END,\"bookableItems\":[{\"bookableId\":\"$BOOKABLE_ID\",\"amount\":1}],\"name\":\"Max Mustermann\",\"mail\":\"max@example.com\",\"company\":\"Muster GmbH\",\"status\":\"confirmed\"}" | head -c 600
echo
echo "TENANT_ID=$TENANT_ID" > /tmp/seed.env
echo "BOOKABLE_ID=$BOOKABLE_ID" >> /tmp/seed.env
EOF
bash seed.sh
